other_conditions: Must belong to the listed Other Backward Classes: Banjara, Baladiya, Labana, Gadia‑Lohar, Gadolia, Gujar, Gurjar, Raika, Raibari (Debasi), Gadariya (Gadri), Gayari
If employed, the student must be a full‑time student taking leave without pay for the entire course
All children of the same parent/guardian are eligible
Must not be receiving any other scholarship or allowance from central, state or public sources
benefits_summary: Provides free education-related supplies and a monthly cash scholarship (₹50–₹120 per month, varying by class and gender) to eligible students.
